_comment: Declarative MCP server set for Claude Code user scope. Applied by register.py (or the recipe's mcp_register build hook), which does remove-then-add per entry so re-running is safe. Each stdio entry mirrors `claude mcp add --scope user <name> -- <command> [args...]`. Only stdio (command) entries are handled by the example. Keys starting with _ are ignored.

mytool._comment: First-party binary from the thismoon source: pure stdio, no secrets, no file writes — registered directly, no wrapper.

mysandboxed._comment: Sandboxed: launched through the wrapper, which cd-s to /, scrubs env, and execs the binary under mytool.sb (no network, no writes, $HOME reads default-denied). Use for anything you want confined.
